resource_risks.description: The breadcrumb home action could bypass existing section activation behavior.
resource_risks.mitigation: Reuse the same primeSectionActivation and openSection calls as the activity rail home action.
evidence: Browser smoke home click returned activeSection overview

resource_risks.description: The desktop minimum width could keep mobile layouts wider than the viewport.
resource_risks.mitigation: Under max-width 960px, set main, desktop-app-root, and desktop-app-shell width to 100% and min-width to 0.

resource_risks.description: Browser smoke uses a local Next.js development server that must be stopped.
resource_risks.mitigation: Serve on dedicated local port 3227, close the browser tab, stop with Ctrl-C, and verify no listener remains.
